notes.title: Another Small Patch!
notes.content:
Hello,

We've got a small patch with a fix to the game.

[list]
[*] Fixed UI to support widescreen monitors
[*] Reduced game file size from 1.5 GB to 800 MB
[/list]

If you have seen any bugs or want to request a feature, don't hesitate to contact us via Community Hub or our Discord server.

notes.title: Small Patch!
notes.content:
Hello,

Today we come with a small patch with some tweaks and a fix to the game.

[list]
[*] The evolve panel doesn't show up if you load a game save in which you're playing an extra wave
[*] Tweaks to the gameplay
[/list]

If you have seen any bugs or want to request a feature, please contact us via Community Hub or via our Discord server.

notes.title: Achievements & Winter Sale!
notes.content:
Hello,

We've got a fresh new update on Monos!
The update brings:
 - 25 Achievements!
 - Bug fixes for controller/steam deck players 
 - Now if you start a wave without anything built, a pop-up will appear to confirm.
 - 20% discount during the winter sale!

We hope that this update will improve the experience of the game.
(If you think there are some issues with the achievements or controller support, please don't hesitate to contact us.)

Happy holidays!

notes.title: Version 1.3 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 
We have some exciting news for you! 

Today's patch may be small, but it's packed with significant changes and fixes! We've taken into consideration the feedback regarding the difficulty of the game in the later levels and made some tweaks to give you a more pleasant experience. 
[b]We've also started testing the Controller support and Achievements and those will be available in a future update. [/b]
Stay tuned for more info!

 - Fixed multiple clipping and graphical issues
 - Tweaked the price cost for some upgrades
 - Reworked how we handle the drop rate of coins in the later levels

Have fun,
EvilStar Studios

notes.title: Version 1.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Based on player reports, today's update for Monos: The Endless Tower contains various improvements and bug fixes. 

[b]Patch Notes:[/b]

 - Fixed an issue where sometimes the enemies will remain stuck at 0 health
 - Fixed an issue where weapons will not be attached to their respective tower segment after a load into the game
 - Reworked the way we handle the Tutorial level after the first time you start a new game
 - Small improvements to some textures and materials


Thank you,
EvilStar Studios

notes.title: Day One Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 

Now that Monos: The Endless Tower has officially launched, we want to ensure that your gaming experience is nothing short of extraordinary. 
That's why we strongly recommend applying the Day 1 patch.

Most notable fixes are:

 - Fixed a bug where the player would sometimes lose the ability to see enemies through towers
 - Fixed a rare case where sometimes the attack SFX is not played
 - Fixed a bug where pressing the ESC key while in the settings menu would redirect directly to the game
 - Fixed a bug that could lead to some missing paths in the Underground Tier
 - Fixed a rare case where sometimes the old tower segment doesn't disappear

Have fun!
EvilStar Studios

notes.title: Pre-Release Demo Update
notes.content:
As we gear up for the full release of Monos: The Endless Tower, we're thrilled to announce that we've just dropped a major update to the game's demo! 🎮

Here's a sneak peek at some of the enhancements you can expect in the updated demo:

🛠️ Balancing Tweaks: We've been adjusting game mechanics to ensure that Monos offers the perfect blend of difficulty and fun. Your strategic skills will truly shine in this unique tower defense.

🌟 Quality of Life Improvements: We've listened to your suggestions and made various quality of life improvements to enhance your overall gameplay experience. From smoother gameplay to updated visuals and many more.

🆕 Updated Content: We've refreshed the demo with the latest content, so even if you've played it before, you'll find new surprises waiting for you. The endless tower awaits!

Have fun!
EvilStar Studios

notes.title: Demo for Strategy Fest on 28th!
notes.content:
Hello, 

[b]On 28th August a new demo will appear![/b]
With the occasion of Steam Strategy Fest we will launch a new version of our demo, that has been in work since March of this year.


[h3]What will be new[/h3]
 [list]
[*] Improved Tutorial
[*] Upgrades Menu
[*] New UI
[*] Tutorial pop-ups
[*] New towers and powers
[*] Around 30 minutes of gameplay
[*] A new zone, that will be playable for the first time
[/list]


[b]Please keep in mind this product is still in work and the demo will get updates in the future so any type of feedback is welcome[/b]

notes.title: Demo for Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Hello, 

[b]We're ready to unveil the steam next fest demo![/b]
Last week we released a sneaky build to test and gather a bit of feedback to be better prepared for Steam Next Fest.

Below you will find a short list of the things we've added and changed since the last time you played the game.

[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] 10 New waves
[*] Tower Expansion feature is now available
[*] A new Special power: Explosion
[*] Added the option to adjust the Game Volume
[*] Added the option to adjust the Graphic Quality of the game
[*] Added the option to adjust the Resolution of the game
[*] Added ''Exit'' button after finishing the Demo
[*] Added Feedback Form to both Pause Menu and ''Demo end'' pop up
[/list]

[h3]Balance and Quality of Life Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Multiple tweaks related to the difficulty of the game
[*] Tweaks to weapon's slots placement
[*] Tweaks to Tutorial Cards description and order
[*] Enemies from the Tutorial cards now have the correct name
[*] Changed the crystal weapon's icon
[*] Added coin icon in weapon selection wheel
[*] Multiple tweaks related to UI and Game textures and materials
[*] Improvements to the overall Global Illumination
[*] Boss from Wave 9 has a new skin now
[*] The Special power buttons are invisible until the user unlocks them
[*] The game will no longer use the system language
[*] Vsync is now added by default
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed multiple clipping issues
[*] Fixed an rare issue where users would be able to move around the tower without holding Left Click
[*] Fixed an issue where the settings for Quality and Resolution would not be saved after a restart
[*] Fixed an issue where the players who are using a controller would not be able to select the first weapon slot in some specific cases
[*] Fixed an issue where the players would be able to see under the fog under specific scenarios
[*] Fixed a rare issue where the Zap button would dissapear in some specific waves
[*] Multiple issues that were present when playing with a controller are now fixed
[/list]

[b]Please keep in mind this product is still in work and the demo will get updates in the future, and we haven't covered everything that we wanted in time, but we did our best for Steam Next Fest![/b]
